title: Compose an email with a fluent builder
description: EmailBuilder constructs an Email via a fluent chain. Each method returns the builder so calls can be chained. to() is the only required field — build() throws if it is missing. cc() and attach() can be called multiple times and accumulate into lists. Fill in the empty method bodies.
hints: cc() and attach() should add to a list, not replace the previous value
build() should throw IllegalStateException when 'to' is null or blank
issues: Building an email with optional cc recipients and attachments leads to many constructor overloads
Nothing enforces that a recipient is always provided before the email is sent
overallGoal: Use the Fluent Builder pattern to compose an Email incrementally through a readable method chain, accumulating repeated fields and validating only what is truly required.
goals: All methods return 'this' to enable chaining
cc() and attach() accumulate values into lists across multiple calls
build() throws IllegalStateException when 'to' is not set
